turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor, I’m a 31-year-old woman, and I’ve been having intermittent flank pain for about five months. I’ve also had multiple urinary tract infections over the past couple of years, though I haven’t had any recent fever, weight loss, or noticeable changes in my urinary or bowel habits.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing a sudden and strong need to urinate, even when your bladder isn't full?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed a sudden, strong need to urinate when my bladder isn’t full. It’s mainly the intermittent flank pain that’s been bothering me.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any firm or hard areas in my breasts, and I don’t have any breast changes that feel different from normal tissue.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, firm bumps on your skin that are smooth to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any small, firm bumps on my skin—nothing smooth to the touch or otherwise that seems unusual. If anything, my skin hasn’t had new lumps or rashes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing a hard time cooling down or feeling like your body temperature is staying elevated, even when you're in a cool environment or not physically active?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had trouble cooling down or felt like my temperature stays elevated, and I don’t notice symptoms like unusual sweating or feeling feverish—especially when I’m not physically active.”

turns.patient_answer: “Emotionally, I’ve been feeling fairly normal—no major pressure or anxiety beyond the stress of dealing with the ongoing flank pain. It’s not causing me to feel constantly overwhelmed or significantly affecting my day-to-day mood.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a sensation of something crawling on your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any itching or any sensation of something crawling on my skin. My skin has felt normal, and I haven’t noticed any new rashes or abnormal sensations.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on my arms—my skin looks and feels normal there. I haven’t had any new marks or vein-related changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in your muscles, like feeling hard to move or relax certain parts of your body?
